description:
Give your baby the foundation for restful sleep with the Crib Mattress from Old Time Oak. Designed to fit all OTO convertible cribs perfectly, this mattress provides the ideal balance of comfort and support for infants and toddlers.
The mattress features a firm yet comfortable sleeping surface that meets all federal safety standards for infant sleep. The durable cover is easy to clean with a damp cloth, making those inevitable messes quick to handle. It fits snugly in your OTO crib with no gaps around the edges, ensuring a safe sleep environment.
Whether used in crib mode, toddler bed configuration, or as a replacement mattress, this versatile piece delivers consistent quality and comfort. Pair it with your favorite fitted sheets and bedding for a cozy sleep space your baby will love. Designed to last through multiple children.
